review:
A lucky-cat jackpot game on 243 ways. Alongside the normal wild, there's a Coin Wild, and every coin you collect raises your chance of reaching the jackpot round – the eighth coin makes it certain.

The jackpot round awards one of four jackpots, and every Coin Wild in free spins triggers it too. Golden symbols pay more, and picking two or more makes Coin Wilds start appearing. Free spins can pay up to 3,000x, while BGaming describes the Grand jackpot as 200,000x the base bet. Medium-high volatility, 96.38% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
